newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks modestly higher in early morning.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks modestly higher in early morning.

text.p: Tokyo stocks posted modest gains in early morning trade on Tuesday, with the market maintaining Monday's firm tone. But profit-taking pressure capped the upside, brokers said.

By 0009 GMT, the Nikkei 225 average had gained 82.00 points, or 0.40 percent, to trade at 20,533.85. June Nikkei futures were up 110 points to 20,550. "Buying is being seen in a broad range of issues," said a broker at a medium-sized securities house.
Blue-chip issues in the high-technology sector continued to attract investors, brokers said.
But they also said that profit-taking pressure was expected to be strong above 20,500 points.
